title: Heads Carolina Tails California
text:
This is a post with executable code.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Bayesian Beta-Binomial Update",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    sliderInput("n", "Number of trials (n):", min = 1, max = 300, value = 50),
    sliderInput('successes', "Number of Successes (k):", min = 0, max = 300, value = 10),
    hr(),
    helpText("Prior Hyperparameters:"),
    sliderInput('alpha', "Prior alpha (α):", min = 1, max = 100, value = 2),
    sliderInput('beta', "Prior beta (β):", min = 1, max = 100, value = 2)
  ),
  card(
    card_header("Posterior Distribution"),
    plotOutput("plot")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Logic to ensure successes cannot exceed n
  observe({
    if (input$successes > input$n) {
      updateSliderInput(session, "successes", value = input$n)
    }
  })

  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    # Calculate posterior parameters
    post_alpha <- input$alpha + input$successes
    post_beta  <- input$beta + (input$n - input$successes)
    
    # Generate distribution curve
    x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 500)
    prior <- dbeta(x, input$alpha, input$beta)
    posterior <- dbeta(x, post_alpha, post_beta)
    
    # Plotting
    plot(x, posterior, type = "l", col = "#007bc2", lwd = 3,
         xlab = "Probability of Success (θ)", 
         ylab = "Density",
         main = "Shift from Prior to Posterior")
    
    # Add Prior for comparison
    lines(x, prior, col = "gray", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    
    legend("topright", legend = c("Posterior", "Prior"), 
           col = c("#007bc2", "gray"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 2)
    
    grid()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
